title: Fulton Extraction System
description: This project add a fulton extraction system to Minecraft
body:
Fulton Extraction System brings a Metal Gear Solid V–inspired extraction mechanic into Minecraft.

Capture mobs, blocks, chests, and full structures, store them safely, and deploy them whenever you want — all through a clean, stable UI.

FEATURES
• Tranquilizer Pistol with non-lethal sleep effect
• Fulton Extractor for mobs, blocks, chests, and structures
• Chest & container extraction preserves ALL contents
• Structure extraction works at ANY size
• Unlimited storage for mobs, blocks, structures, and items
• Mass Extract / Mass Deploy buttons
• Ally system for deployed mobs
• Safe instant deployment (no falling damage, no collisions)
• Clean UI inspired by MGSV
• Work with mobs from another mods

REQUIREMENTS
• Minecraft 1.21.5
• Fabric Loader
• Fabric API
